verdictSummary: Eight of the twelve held cases close, conditional on the supported patch: three chronology cases and five English-name cases. The owner's chronology and person-record operations are exact and correct. As proposed, the patch fails native validation once its own English repairs are applied, because the bound English surfaces were not updated. Its English supplement also omitted s0118 and s0220/s0222, which the held cases p083 and p019 depend on. The supported patch adds those pieces. Four witness-gap holds remain because the host witness code is unchanged. The chapter is not certifiable until those four close and the host applies the patch and reruns the date and editorial gates.

verifiedText.zh: 及莊宗平定汴、洛，時盧程以狂妄免，郭崇韜自勳臣拜，議者以為國朝典禮故實，須訪前代名家，咸曰光允有宰相器。
verifiedText.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong pacified Bian and Luoyang, Lu Cheng was dismissed for arrogance and Guo Chongtao was appointed from among meritorious ministers. Commentators held that the dynasty's ritual and precedents required consulting celebrated masters of former ages, and all said Guangyun had the makings of a chief minister.
verifiedText.literal: When Zhuangzong pacified Bian and Luo, Lu Cheng was dismissed for arrogance and Guo Chongtao was appointed from among meritorious ministers. Commentators held that the dynasty's ritual and precedents required consulting celebrated masters of former ages, and all said Guangyun had the makings of a chief minister.

verifiedText.zh: 郭崇韜采言事者雲，廷珪朽老，浮華無相業；
verifiedText.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao adopted the words of memorialists, saying Tinggui was decrepit and aged, showy without ministerial substance;
verifiedText.literal: Guo Chongtao adopted the words of memorialists, saying Tinggui was decrepit and aged, showy without ministerial substance;

verifiedText.zh: 事下中書，光允謂崇韜曰：「復恭與山南謀逆，顯當國法，本朝未經昭雪，安得論理？」
verifiedText.idiomatic: When the matter reached the Secretariat, Guangyun said to Guo Chongtao, "Fu Gong conspired in rebellion with the Shannan faction and plainly deserved punishment under the law. Our dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his estates be claimed?"
verifiedText.literal: The matter was sent down to the Secretariat, and Guangyun said to Chongtao, "Fu Gong plotted rebellion with Shannan and clearly deserved the national law; the present dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his case be argued?"

verifiedText.zh: 崇韜私抑宦者，因具奏聞。
verifiedText.idiomatic: Chongtao privately blocked the eunuch's claim and submitted a full report to the throne.
verifiedText.literal: Chongtao privately restrained the eunuch and therefore submitted a full report to the throne.

verifiedText.zh: 張全義言於郭崇韜，將復相之，尋入為太子賓客。
verifiedText.idiomatic: Zhang Quanyi spoke to Guo Chongtao about restoring him as chief minister, and he was soon recalled as guest of the heir apparent.
verifiedText.literal: Zhang Quanyi spoke to Guo Chongtao about restoring him as chief minister; soon afterward he entered court as Guest of the Heir Apparent.
